title: Study 3 crossomics coordination benchmark
author: Vusumuzi Mabasa
disclosure: Entirely synthetic gene modules; no patient, TACA, Clin-MAP or empirical African LD data.

dependence.primary_endpoint: Probability of detecting the altered prespecified module with family-wise calibration over four modules
dependence.calibration: For each N/method/family use the strict ascending rank 476/500 of family maxima within each of five null banks; threshold is the maximum across banks. Averaged bank-specific bound 25/501. No FDR claim. Stress mechanisms outside the calibration bank.

integration.selection: Choose K by training-only masked RNA/protein reconstruction; select starting point by training ELBO. Refit selected K with two starts. No subtype or independent-test outcomes in integration tuning.
integration.matched_budget: Raw-Gaussian and rank-likelihood Gibbs comparators share normal loading and inverse-gamma residual priors, chain lengths and the K selected for raw MOFA+.
integration.diagnostics: A monitored split Rhat >=1.1 triggers a single threefold-length same-seed extension. Retain unresolved flags.
integration.secondary_validation: Independent test participants and separately reported held-out synthetic-country transportability; supervised DIABLO with train-only inner validation.

policy: Freeze source hashes before calibration/evaluation. Preserve all original outputs. No performance-driven threshold, scenario or seed changes. Record failures and diagnose any implementation errors transparently.
